title_en: Character Riddles (8/20): A Little Bird Opens Its Beak
note_en: 鸟鸣阵阵 "birdsong comes in waves" uses the measure word 阵, repeated, for something that comes in bursts. Grandpa spells it out: 一阵一阵地传来鸟叫声 "birdsong drifted over burst after burst." Repeating a measure word, as in 阵阵 or 一阵一阵, means "one after another," where English needs a phrase like "wave after wave."
